# IBD-Control-VAS

## Setting up in R

Load R packages required.

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(survival)
library(patchwork)

```

## Helper functions

```{r}
print_survival <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    broom::tidy(exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    # Relocate columns
    dplyr::select(term, estimate, std.error, statistic, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
    # 3 significant figures
    dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(.cols = where(is.numeric), .fns = ~ signif(.x, 3))) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p.value = as.character(p.value)) %>%
    knitr::kable(col.names = c("Covariate",
                               "Hazard Ratio",
                               "Std. Error",
                               "Statistic",
                               "Lower 95% CI",
                               "Upper 95% CI",
                               "P-value"),
                 format.args = list(drop0trailing = TRUE)
                 )
}
```

## Load data

```{r}
# File paths
data.path <- "/Volumes/igmm/cvallejo-predicct/predicct/final/20221004/"
chiara <- "/Volumes/igmm/cvallejo-predicct/people/chiara/"
alex_data <- "/Volumes/igmm/cvallejo-predicct/people/Alex/Predicct2/Data"


# Baseline control
control <- readr::read_rds(
  glue::glue("{alex_data}/control.rds")
)

# Monthly questionnaires
control_followup <- readr::read_rds(
  glue::glue("{alex_data}/control_followup.rds")
)

common_variables <- readr::read_rds(
  file.path(alex_data, "common_variables.rds")
)

flares_hard <- readRDS(paste0(chiara, "flares_hard.RDS"))
flares_soft <- readRDS(paste0(chiara, "flares_soft.RDS"))
```

## Data cleaning

```{r}
# Combine with baseline

# Only include those with a value at baseline
control_followup %<>%
  dplyr::filter(ParticipantNo %in% control$ParticipantNo)

control %<>%
  dplyr::mutate(Q_month = 0) %>%
  dplyr::bind_rows(control_followup) %>%
  dplyr::rename(month = Q_month) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ParticipantNo) %>%
  tidyr::fill(SiteNo) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::arrange(ParticipantNo, month) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    common_variables %>%
      dplyr::select(
        ParticipantNo,
        diagnosis2,
        age_decade,
        Sex,
        IMD,
        FC,
        Smoke
      ),
    by = "ParticipantNo"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    OverallControl_grouped = dplyr::case_when(
      OverallControl >= 85 ~ ">=85",
      OverallControl < 85 ~ "<85",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    OverallControl_grouped = factor(
      OverallControl_grouped,
      levels = c("<85", ">=85")
    )
  )


# Survival data
data_soft_long <- control %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    flares_soft %>% dplyr::select(ParticipantNo, softflare, softflare_time),
    by = "ParticipantNo"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(DiseaseFlareYN = softflare, time = softflare_time)

data_hard_long <- control %>%
  dplyr::inner_join(
    flares_hard %>% dplyr::select(ParticipantNo, hardflare, hardflare_time),
    by = "ParticipantNo"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(DiseaseFlareYN = hardflare, time = hardflare_time)

```

## Counts

```{r}
custom_theme = theme_minimal() + 
  theme(
    title = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.tag.position = c(0.55, 0.85),
    plot.tag = element_text(size = 12)
  )

palette <- c("#FFA500", "#0072B2", "grey")


# Complete for missing
data_soft_long_counts <- data_soft_long %>%
  tidyr::complete(ParticipantNo, month)

# Fill in the DiseaseFlare and time
data_soft_long_counts %<>%
  dplyr::group_by(ParticipantNo) %>%
  tidyr::fill(DiseaseFlareYN, time) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

# Post flare flag
data_soft_long_counts %<>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    post_flare_flag = (DiseaseFlareYN == 1 & time < as.numeric(month)*365/12)
    ) %>%
  # still at risk
  dplyr::mutate(
    at_risk_flag = (time >= as.numeric(month)*365/12)
  )

# Month
data_soft_long_counts %<>%
  dplyr::mutate(month = factor(month))

  

# No previous flare
plot_soft_pre <- data_soft_long_counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    month != 0,
    at_risk_flag == TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    OverallControl_grouped = forcats::fct_na_value_to_level(OverallControl_grouped, "Missing"),
    OverallControl_grouped = forcats::fct_relevel(OverallControl_grouped, "Missing", "<85", ">=85")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(month, OverallControl_grouped) %>%
  # Calculate percentage
  dplyr::group_by(month) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p = n/sum(n[OverallControl_grouped != "Missing"]),
    mid = rev(cumsum(rev(n))) - n/2,
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::mutate(    
    percent = glue::glue("{round(p*100)}%")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    percent = dplyr::case_when(
      OverallControl_grouped == "Missing" ~ NA,
      TRUE ~ percent
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = n, fill = OverallControl_grouped)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = month, y = mid, label = percent),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 2000, 250),
    limits = c(0, 2000)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = palette,
    breaks = c("<85", ">=85", "Missing")
  ) +
  labs(
    fill = "IBD-Control-VAS",
    tag = "Still at risk of patient-reported flare"
  ) +
  xlab("Month") +
  ylab("Count") +
  custom_theme



# Post flare
plot_soft_post <- data_soft_long_counts %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    month != 0,
    post_flare_flag == TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    OverallControl_grouped = forcats::fct_na_value_to_level(OverallControl_grouped, "Missing"),
    OverallControl_grouped = forcats::fct_relevel(OverallControl_grouped, "Missing", "<85", ">=85")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::count(month, OverallControl_grouped) %>%
  # Calculate percentage
  dplyr::group_by(month) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    p = n/sum(n[OverallControl_grouped != "Missing"]),

  ) %>%

  ) %>%

      TRUE ~ percent
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = n, fill = OverallControl_grouped)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.8, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(x = month, y = mid, label = percent),
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 700, 100),
    limits = c(0, 700)
  ) +

  ) +

  ) +
```

## Extended Cox model with time-dependent covariates

### Data preparation

```{r}

data_soft_static <- data_soft_long %>%
  dplyr::select(
    ParticipantNo, SiteNo, diagnosis2, Sex, age_decade, FC, Smoke, IMD, time, DiseaseFlareYN
  ) %>%
  # One row per person
  dplyr::group_by(ParticipantNo) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  # Remove people with time 0
  dplyr::filter(
    time > 0
  )

data_soft_td <- data_soft_long %>%
  dplyr::select(
    ParticipantNo, month, OverallControl
  ) %>%
  # Last observation carried forward
  dplyr::arrange(ParticipantNo, month) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ParticipantNo) %>%
  tidyr::fill(OverallControl, .direction = "down") %>%
  # Convert month to days to match time
  dplyr::mutate(
    month = as.numeric(month),
    day = 365*month/12)

# Start stop
data_soft_merged <- tmerge(
  data_soft_static, 
  data_soft_static, 
  id = ParticipantNo, 
  endpoint = event(time, DiseaseFlareYN)) %>%
  tmerge(
    data2 = data_soft_td,
    id = ParticipantNo,
    OverallControl = tdc(day, OverallControl)
  )




## Hard ####
data_hard_static <- data_hard_long %>%
  dplyr::select(
    ParticipantNo, SiteNo, diagnosis2, Sex, age_decade, FC, Smoke, IMD, time, DiseaseFlareYN
  ) %>%
  # One row per person
  dplyr::group_by(ParticipantNo) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  # Remove people with time 0
  dplyr::filter(
    time > 0
  )

data_hard_td <- data_hard_long %>%
  dplyr::select(
    ParticipantNo, month, OverallControl
  ) %>%
  # Last observation carried forward
  dplyr::arrange(ParticipantNo, month) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ParticipantNo) %>%
  tidyr::fill(OverallControl, .direction = "down") %>%
  # Convert month to days to match time
  dplyr::mutate(
    month = as.numeric(month),
    day = 365*month/12)

# Start stop
data_hard_merged <- tmerge(
  data_hard_static, 
  data_hard_static, 
  id = ParticipantNo, 
  endpoint = event(time, DiseaseFlareYN)) %>%
  tmerge(
    data2 = data_hard_td,
    id = ParticipantNo,
    OverallControl = tdc(day, OverallControl)
  )


```

### Results

#### Crohn's disease

```{r}
# Time dependent cox model
# CD
data_soft_merged_cd <- data_soft_merged %>% dplyr::filter(diagnosis2 == 'CD')
data_hard_merged_cd <- data_hard_merged %>% dplyr::filter(diagnosis2 == 'CD')
```

##### Patient-reported flare

```{r}

cox_soft_cd <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, endpoint) ~ 
    OverallControl +
    IMD +
    Sex +
    age_decade +
    FC +
    Smoke +
    frailty(SiteNo),
  data = data_soft_merged_cd
)

cox_soft_cd %>%
  print_survival()

```

##### Objective flare

```{r}
 
cox_hard_cd <- coxph(
  Surv(tstart, tstop, endpoint) ~ 
    OverallControl +
    IMD +
    Sex +
    age_decade +
    FC +
    Smoke +
    frailty(SiteNo),
  data = data_hard_merged_cd
)

cox_hard_cd %>%
  print_survival()

```

#### Ulcerative colitis

```{r}
# Time dependent cox model
data_soft_merged_uc <- data_soft_merged %>% dplyr::filter(diagnosis2 == 'UC/IBDU')
data_hard_merged_uc <- data_hard_merged %>% dplyr::filter(diagnosis2 == 'UC/IBDU')
```
